g.text: Implementing ADR 0001: stage C first and stabilised, then the waves (fork = tasks that may run together)
(#253, #254 merged; Program.cs frozen for outside PRs)
Stage C Program.cs becomes a composition root (behaviour-neutral)
C-1 defect: board reading ignores other repositories
C0 safety net: golden writes, route-and-auth table,
in-process calls, start-up test, CI job for smoke and parity
C1 classes after app.Run to files
C2 dashboard and connect prompt as embedded resources
C5a AddGateway*, IPlantHooks, InProcess via EndpointDataSource
C7a modules: health, status, metrics, dashboard,
C7b modules: runtime hosts, Copilot, transcripts,
webhook, demo, item and worker admin
C8 policies, statics to DI, architecture test
stabilisation gate: architecture test; golden writes unchanged;
2 measured tdd batches; promoted to uat and prod; 2 quiet weeks
gate: tdd batch no slower; golden baseline re-recorded
gate: golden writes identical to the W0-gate baseline
W2..W9 (the plan's tables are the source for their tasks, parallel groups and gates)
